the milk NPN fraction is not an accurate index for evaluating dietary protein status in the lactating dairy animal.
the concentration of milk protein is not affected by dietary protein or energy.
milk NPN is an indicator of the dietary N and E balance for the lactating cow and may be used to evaluate the adequacy of protein and energy in the ration.

the NPN fraction is a good indicator of the N status of the cow, but the protein fraction of milk N is not.
